text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly buying Stock E and then selling it in several losing trades suggests I need a clear reason and exit rule before entering, not a sequence of reactions to price moves.","Doing nothing through the declines in Periods 6 and 7 did not protect the account; I should review portfolio risk regularly and act only when evidence or my plan warrants it.","My account ended below its starting value, but without market comparisons I cannot judge relative performance; I will track returns against a suitable benchmark over a longer period."]}
